jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Hevo
 
Hevo moves data for more than 2,000 companies, including IcelandAir, Shopify, Postman, ThoughtSpot. What looks simple on the surface sits on top of some of the most complex machinery in software: pipelines pulling from 150+ sources, running every hour of every day, failing in a hundred different ways and recovering before anyone notices.
 
Your job is to make all of that feel obvious.
 
This is one of the harder product design jobs going in India right now, and we want you to know that upfront. You are not designing a three-screen consumer app or a marketing site. You are designing for data engineers and analysts. They are technical, they are in a hurry, and they have no patience for design that gets in their way. If a workflow confuses them, they do not "figure it out." They leave. Good design here is not decoration. It is the product.
